summary: Accepted the focused DOM input serialization and checked-property repair. Source and pinned evidence support the attempt-06 form fix, four focused browser tests, within-DOM keyed identity, focus, and backward-selection behavior. Full four-app/five-fixture integration and cross-backend focus restoration remain outside this acceptance.

behavior: For input elements, ordinary attributes remain in input order before type and value; checked is excluded from serialized attributes.
The checked flag is applied to the live input.checked property.
The GoScript-shaped browser test checks the form HTML, live controls, messages, keyed node retention, focus, and backward selection after update.
A separate test covers keyed reorder identity and selection within the DOM renderer.

attempt_06_form_failure.stage: first React-to-DOM swap after text edit

red_green.red_result: failed on the exact initial input outerHTML order against the pre-repair renderer
red_green.warning: The green run reports a non-failing UNDICI-EHPA experimental EnvHttpProxyAgent warning.

limits: Reviewer inspected saved R-DOM source hashes and red/green logs; no second Chromium process was launched while N3's current integration run was active.
The focused identity and selection tests exercise updates/reordering inside the DOM renderer; they do not test React-to-DOM physical node identity or cross-backend focus transfer.
The current N3 four-app/five-fixture form-positive result was not available in this review; this acceptance covers only the focused R-DOM repair.
